finding: The study found that women with rheumatic disease had a high rate of cesarean delivery (48.6%) and pregnancy complications such as diabetes (18.4%), hypertension (9.7%), anemia (25.4%), and postpartum hemorrhage (11.5%).
mod_finding: Women with antiphospholipid antibodies had a significantly higher rate of preterm delivery before 32 weeks.
gest_age: Most women (63.8%) gave birth after 37 weeks of pregnancy
